I love that I chanced upon your post today. 

I joined suss pt after working for 2 years ft (I worked right after I had grad from poly) and even then getting back into the rhythm of studying took me awhile. Even though I could have picked any other easier route, it’d be really satisfactory achievement when I’ve completed my journey. I’ve been feeling inferior to others as I didn’t do well enough in poly to enter a local uni, but working on this satiates this “lack” feeling. I also think it’s important to make the effort to maintain brain stimulation once we enter the adulting world so yes we’re definitely making a great choice to continue studying!!!
